lines: Phases 1 to 5 complete. Phase 6 in progress. The decision asked of Brandon in Status 236 at about 5:20 PM MT Friday stands unanswered: move on to the film and the masters, or one more round of looks first. The work goes on in either case and only the freeze waits.

Spring's glass after a shake is accepted (decision 252) and stands in chain 42, which a helper machine is checking now. It is not on main and not on the live page yet. Read and looked at here: the branch's head equals the reported one, and its pictures show drops and runs on the glass at the landing where main is bare, at the page's low, medium and high quality. Stated by its builder: all 26 runs have a head and a trail as at rest, the other seven guard pictures are equal, the whole test run 1061 passed and 8 skipped. Below the bar, by its word and mine: on the pale storm the trails are pale on pale, one bunch sits at the upper right, and no run shows from film frame 684 to 700. Not seen yet: the strip at every frame on the merged tree and a 4K pair with the globe standing still, both asked of chain 42.

The petals' weave in the film (item 278): the builder's last mend shows a gain in a trial, not merged. Stated by it at 3840x2160 at the masters' tier: the rib at film frame 1388 measures 1.66 levels on main and 0.83 with the mend, at the cost of a finer soft grain. Looked at here at two times: the ribs and the weave are gone and a soft grain without a pattern remains. The trial was not drawn on the pushed head, so five helper machines now draw film frames 1388, 1389, 668, 2108 and 2121 at 4K on it. If the floors hold it goes into chain 43.

The stall at low quality on a software renderer: the cause is found (decision 251). Stated by its builder: with the colour fades of the controls off the stall came in 0 of 40 presses, with them on in 9 of 16 named presses. Its mend keeps the same look and is being proven against six floors. Its two reports are due about 8:40 PM and 9:20 PM MT. Nothing of it is on main.

The final render on his own computer. The Direct3D mend's first part passed (decision 253). Measured by the builder of the one file on a hosted Windows machine, which draws in software: 113 programs linked, 0 errors, and no warning left on the tests for a broken number. Left for its parts two and three: cautions on five functions, one shadow read in a loop and one program whose optimization did not converge. The whole is due about 9:11 PM MT. The one file: its short test failed on all five hosted Windows jobs because the work could not be started in the background. Mended by its builder, unproven until its next run. Decision 254: the tool gets a word to send the four finished files back as a draft release, only on Brandon's yes and only to a private repo. Unknown still: anything on a real NVIDIA card. No final render is started in the cloud.

Remaining in phase 6 and what he receives. Chain 42: spring's glass after a shake. Chain 43: the petals' weave, the frost line at film frame 668, summer's fireflies and the seeds' dots, as each passes. Chain 44: the stall's mend and the Direct3D mend. Then a critic for the change of season and a fourteenth publish at the same address. The render instructions: one file in the repo and one line to give Claude Code. Its builder's guess for the last report is about 2:00 AM MT Saturday. On his word the freeze: the repo goes private and the references are redrawn. Then the film steps of the build order (card loop, judged stills, record round, preview films, proof of the local render, cue sheet, README, last publish, gauntlet) and the full 4K 60 render on his gaming PC on his word: With Prompt and Without Prompt at 3840x2160, the Portfolio Looping Video and the Portfolio Screenshot. Last, a fresh reviewer's score against the showcase standard.

Open, below the bar: summer's landing streaks whiter and coarser than approved and its base darker. Summer's pond at rest, flat pale plates where the approved has dark water (item 279). Fall's storm paler than approved. Spring's glass bare after a shake on the live page (mend in chain 42, pale on pale). Spring's fence and trails. The fireflies' flat bars at 4K (item 276). The seeds' lumps of dots at the stills' close camera (item 277). The petals' weave at film frames 1388 and 1389 (item 278, a third mend in proof). The frost line at film frame 668 (item 275). The stall at low quality on a software renderer. Winter's four small items. Fall's near fence and the pumpkin's stepped face (item 272). The petals' fringe at film frame 680. The poster tool that stops on one failed request (item 273, cause not found).
Sound credits 7,420 of 10,000 (measured from the ledger at 02:05 UTC: 52 calls), no call since 05:47 UTC on Thursday (10:47 PM MT Wednesday). No film render and no new preview since Preview 07.
